'''Novane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kadas'sa'Nikto/Legends|Kadas'sa'Nikto]] criminal who was a henchman of a local [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Novane's lieutenants were known as "Cold-Blooded Brothers."<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Novane appears as one of the possible Henchmen Bounties in the Bounty Contract Week, a recurring World Event added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in Game Update 2.3. Novane can be summoned by using Rendezvous Beacon G-77, which appears on the planets [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]]. The player has the option to [[Death/Legends|kill]] him or capture him alive with [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]], so as a result, this article refrains from assuming which crime lord he worked for, where he was encountered, and him fate.<ref name="TOR" />
